hero.title: Language Courses in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: Language courses in Mauritius are a good option for students, working professionals and international learners, who want to improve their communication skills for education, employment, travel or everyday life. Universities, cultural institutions and training providers are providing learners with the chance to learn English, French, Chinese and other languages. Language courses in Mauritius provide opportunities to learners with varying levels of proficiency and learning goals. These options also make language learning in Mauritius accessible to people with different academic and professional interests.

universities.name: University of Mauritius (UoM)
universities.desc: UoM is the premier public research university of Mauritius, offering internationally recognized undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in science, engineering, and agriculture.

universities.name: Université des Mascareignes (UdM)
universities.desc: Partnered with Université de Limoges (France), UdM delivers dual European-Mauritian accredited diplomas with bilingual instruction and industry internships.

universities.name: Middlesex University Mauritius
universities.desc: A branch campus of Middlesex University London, delivering British honors degrees with global validation, modern coastal campus, and international faculty.

universities.name: Curtin Mauritius
universities.desc: An international campus of Curtin University Australia, providing accredited Australian business, IT, and humanities degrees in state-of-the-art facilities.
